verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de is a German legal-services platform covering notarization, incorporation, translation, apostilles and tax/trade registration, so hiring and equity paperwork is a fair question for it. The evidence never mentions offer letters, confidentiality/IP agreements, or option grants. Generic document notarization and signer management is an adjacent capability, not one built for running hiring and equity paperwork, so it earns no credit.
